input.prompt:
Find and read Anthropic's official Claude Code documentation overview page. This is a synthetic infrastructure check.

Constraints:
- Use ONLY the WebSearch and WebFetch tools. Do not use any other tools (no Bash, file reads, or anything else).
- Use WebSearch first to locate the official overview page. It should be on an official Anthropic domain, such as docs.claude.com, code.claude.com, or docs.anthropic.com. Do not use third-party sites.
- Then use WebFetch on that URL to read the page and confirm its actual title. If WebFetch reports a cross-host redirect, call WebFetch again on the redirect URL and use the final URL.

Report back:
1. The exact page title as it appears on the fetched page
2. The final URL you fetched successfully (after any redirects)
3. A one-sentence summary of what the page covers, to confirm you read it
4. Whether both WebSearch and WebFetch worked, and any errors or redirects you hit
